void.$description: Void — Page background, full-bleed canvas for all content

bone-white.$description: Bone White — All text, navigation, footer instructions, and thin UI strokes

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Secondary or muted text, de-emphasized labels, inactive hints

akzidenz-grotesk.$description: Sole typeface across navigation, body, footer, and brand mark. The weight 400/700 pairing is the entire hierarchy system — no color, no size jumps, no italic to differentiate roles. At 14–15px the grotesk reads as utilitarian editorial; at 20–21px it becomes signage. Normal tracking preserves the geometric, mechanical feel.
